Covers saved on the phone and one-tap updates.

### What's new
- **Covers stored on your phone**: every cover and artist photo is downloaded once and kept in the app's storage, so it appears instantly next time, even offline. The covers of the next songs in the queue are loaded in advance. The cache cleans itself up past 200 MB.
- **Updates install from the app**: in **Settings → Updates**, **Download** fetches the new version with a progress indicator and opens Android's installer directly. The first time, Android asks you to allow installing apps from ArtistGrid.
- **Correct version check**: the version shown and compared is read from the installed app itself, so "update available" only appears when a newer version really exists.
- A song restored from the last session gets its album cover too.

### Installation
This one last time, download **ArtistGrid.apk** below and open it (or use Download in Settings). From now on updates install from the app. Installs over v1.2.0 and later and keeps your favorites. Requires Android 6.0+.

> Debug build, not signed for the Play Store.
